Idempotency-Replayed.description: "true" when the answer is the stored one of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key (a stored 2xx or 4xx answer, replayed with its original status and body); absent on the first execution. A 5xx is never stored.

schema.description: The versioned notification policy document (ADR 0017). Version 0 is the built-in default (every family NOBODY, publishedAt absent); a published version is immutable and every version is kept.
schema.title: NotificationPolicy

400.description: The request is not valid JSON, has an unknown field contains a NUL character or is larger than 64 KiB (malformed-request; there is no 413), or the Idempotency-Key header is missing (idempotency-key-required) or is not 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters (idempotency-key-invalid).

detail.example: Every shipment group is locked to a node; cancellation is now a return.

409.description: concurrent-update, or the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request (idempotency-key-reused).

detail.example: Every shipment group is locked to a node; cancellation is now a return.

422.description: The body is well-formed JSON but breaks a value-object rule (validation-failed).

detail.example: Every shipment group is locked to a node; cancellation is now a return.
